## Goal
Reimplement the layered model defaults registry after the newer model-normalization stack, using the current provider/model semantics instead of rebasing the stale PR #386 branch.

## Context
- Requested from PR #386: https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/pull/386#issuecomment-4606086073
- PR #386 was closed as superseded because it was based on stale work and predated the focused model stack.
- Issue #384 remains the original tracker for the layered registry idea: https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/issues/384
- The newer foundation is now in place:
  - #388 merged Codex ACP model/reasoning normalization, composing Codex GPT-5 model plus reasoning into IDs like `gpt-5.5/xhigh`.
  - #389 pinned provider defaults (`codex` `gpt-5.5`, `claude` `claude-opus-4-8`) and applied resolver output to review lanes; its code landed through #390 and the PR was closed.
  - #390 merged model metadata display cleanup so suffixed Codex model IDs do not duplicate reasoning in footers.
- The old #386 approach added `.agent/model-defaults.json`, remote registry loading, registry validation/fallback, and `model_source`, but reviewer feedback asked to avoid public `AGENT_MODEL_REGISTRY` / `AGENT_MODEL_REGISTRY_URL` workflow knobs. The desired shape was to check the Sepo-owned GitHub registry by default and fall back to bundled defaults.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Reintroduce a layered model defaults registry on top of the current resolver and normalized Codex ACP model semantics.
- Keep bundled defaults available locally and deterministic for offline/fallback behavior.
- Check the Sepo-owned remote registry by default, with short timeout and deterministic fallback to bundled defaults on fetch/validation failure.
- Avoid adding the two public workflow variables/inputs from the stale PR (`AGENT_MODEL_REGISTRY` and `AGENT_MODEL_REGISTRY_URL`) unless a maintainer explicitly chooses a new configuration surface.
- Preserve precedence: bundled defaults < valid Sepo registry defaults < `AGENT_MODEL_POLICY` default/provider/route overrides < existing inline workflow escape hatches.
- Validate registry data strictly using the current provider/model validation and normalized Codex model-name expectations.
- Expose/log the source of the effective model defaults clearly enough for debugging, without overriding repo-local policy.
- Update docs for default registry behavior, fallback/determinism, and the relationship between registry refresh and agent updates.
- Add focused tests for bundled-only behavior, valid remote registry, timeout/fallback, invalid registry fallback/rejection, policy precedence, reviewer lane behavior, and normalized Codex model IDs such as `gpt-5.5/xhigh`.

---

Requested via issue_comment at https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/pull/386
